translation:
Heading: Now begins the Shri Khandana (the grain-pounding song) ||27||

1. I know nothing of singing or of playing instruments; Hari, Hari - with a single, undivided mind I simply praise the fair Ramji.

2. As I sang of Govind an eager longing took hold of me; Hari, Hari - and the wandering delusion of ten million births was broken.

3. When you sing of Govind, do not hold back out of shyness or regard for what others say; Hari, Hari - for by that singing the dwelling in the womb, birth after birth, will be destroyed.

4. O blind one, why have you forgotten the house of the womb and its suffering? Hari, Hari - you are tied fast in the noose of maya (worldly illusion).

5. Take up the sword of Hari and cut that bond; Hari, Hari - then you will not fall into the grip of this world again.

6. The clatter of coming and going, of birth and death, is broken; Hari, Hari - at his feet I have found Govind and hold him fast.

7. Ramji, Ramji, Ramji, O Ram; Hari, Hari - it is your Name, O Lord, that I wait upon and serve.

8. Wherever I look, there I see Ramji; Hari, Hari - how then could I turn away from him, my beloved Ramkrishna?

9. Wherever I look, there is your radiance; Hari, Hari - show me your affection, O Master of the three worlds.

10. The name of Ram is what carries the three worlds across; Hari, Hari - it wards off hell, O Lord Vasudev.

11. Whoever lives in any manner at all without bhakti (devotion) to Vishnu; Hari, Hari - is like a man with a lamp in his hand who, being blind, still falls into the well.

12. One who utters "Vishnuji, Krishnaji" day and night; Hari, Hari - how could such a one go on being spread out and scattered through the three worlds?

13. Feed on Brahman, worship Parabrahma; Hari, Hari - by Brahman the whole universe has been upheld and delivered.

14. He who fashioned universes so vast as these; Hari, Hari - he set the moon and the sun in them as lamps.

15. If the longing is there, then Vasudev arises within; Hari, Hari - and a Vaishnav (devotee of Vishnu) is made in the company of the saints.

16. May the company of saints be mine, and in great abundance; Hari, Hari - for in that company the fair Ram is found.

17. The guru gave me the sweet of Ram's Name; Hari, Hari - and the hunger of ten million births was broken.

18. Ramji, Ramji, Ramji, O fair one; Hari, Hari - with you the one soul is [unclear: "fudo", apparently "false" or "deceitful"].

19. One man goes to the Ganga and to Gaya and comes back; Hari, Hari - but he who remembers Ramji gains a greater fruit than that.

20. With every single syllable of the Name there is a bathing in the Ganga; Hari, Hari - and he who remembers that holy word attains the supreme state.

Closing: Here the Shri Khandana is complete ||27||
